# GenoMatch

> The world's first genotype-aware dating app for West Africa and the African diaspora.

GenoMatch helps singles match on sickle cell genotype compatibility (AA, AS, SS, AC)
alongside personality and interests, so couples can make informed decisions about
relationships and family planning.

## Key topics

- Genotype compatibility before marriage in Nigeria
- Can AS marry AS? Sickle cell carrier risk
- Sickle cell disease burden in Nigeria and West Africa
- Intentional, health-aware dating for the African diaspora
